invalidation_boundary: All outputs from the pre-correction simulator are invalid for economic claims. They remain only as an append-only audit trail.
corrections: Queue a close-t signal until close t+1 and first earn the t+1-to-t+2 return.
Expose to each signal only observations whose realized-return date is no later than the signal close.
Let portfolio weights drift with asset returns between scheduled rebalances.
Compute turnover at execution against then-drifted holdings.
Evaluate any rebalance band at execution rather than signal time.
Record signal-time weights separately from executed-period weights so offline ensemble plans cannot import one session of future drift.
Rebase entry and terminal costs for every scored partition and annual-origin window.
cost_accounting_convention: Trading and financing costs reduce the period net return but do not alter within-period relative asset holdings; post-return weights are normalized from gross asset returns. This is a proportional cost debit approximation applied identically to every policy and baseline.
purpose: Re-evaluate the already disclosed Generation 1 and Generation 2 formulas under the corrected causal engine before considering any later candidate family.
claim_boundary: All history is seen, revised research data. Passing every retrospective gate can earn SHADOW_ONLY; no historical output proves future profit, submitted-competitor superiority, or historical options P&L.

data.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close
data.null_policy: Use only dates common to every symbol in the applicable panel; never forward fill.
data.frozen_vintage_policy: Persist the normalized panel privately and publish its hash plus per-symbol raw-response and normalized-series hashes. Do not splice providers or backfill pre-inception history.
data.bias_boundary: Yahoo adjusted close is revised, not point-in-time. Today-surviving ETF menus create fund-survival and 2026 menu-selection bias.

execution.entry_cost: Start each scored period from 100% BIL and charge absolute target-minus-BIL turnover.
execution.terminal_cost: At each scored period end, charge liquidation of remaining risky ETF exposure into the BIL sleeve.
execution.leverage_boundary: SPY 1.5x and the TQQQ AEGIS legacy proxy are visible diagnostics only and cannot qualify as the primary champion.

trial_accounting.reason: A conservative deflated-statistics denominator avoids pretending that inspected but rejected ideas never existed.

selection.objective: Among primary candidates passing all pre-robustness gates, maximize the smaller annualized log-growth advantage over SPY in development and validation; then break ties by validation BIL-excess Sharpe, drawdown, and identifier.
selection.recent_interval_role: May veto a hard safety failure after selection but cannot rank, rescue, or break ties.
selection.annual_origin_windows: Use standalone cost-rebased 252/504/756-session windows beginning at each available calendar-year origin inside validation.

raw_return: standalone net annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation annualized log-growth advantage is at least 0.50 percentage points
median validation raw excess is positive in 252/504/756-session annual-origin windows
at least 60% of validation windows at every horizon beat SPY
risk: validation volatility does not exceed SPY
validation drawdown is no worse than SPY by over two percentage points
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and SPY volatility targeting by at least 0.10
validation drawdown is no worse than frozen Finly by over two points and never worse than 15%
robustness_after_preselection: sign survives every native rebalance anchor
Deflated-Sharpe probability is at least 0.95 using at least 92 trials
fixed-candidate familywise circular and moving-block p-value is at most 0.05 for 5/20/60-session blocks
authenticated Alpaca overlap reconciliation passes frozen tolerances for every used symbol
